onboarding.title: How Sehat Awaaz Works
onboarding.step1: Tell us your symptoms by voice or text
onboarding.step2: We'll ask a few questions to understand better
onboarding.step3: Get guidance on what to do next
onboarding.disclaimer: Sehat Awaaz is NOT a medical diagnosis. It helps you understand symptom urgency. Always consult a healthcare professional.

home.placeholder: For example: I have had a headache and fever for 2 days...

landing.headline: Care, heard clearly.
landing.description: A calmer first step when you are not feeling your best. Share symptoms in your own words and get clear guidance on what to do next.
landing.not_diagnosis: Helpful guidance, not a medical diagnosis
landing.console_subtitle: A preview of hands-free symptom input

landing.console_footer: Your language. Your words. A clearer next step.
landing.capabilities_title: Healthcare guidance that starts by listening.
landing.capabilities_description: Accessible symptom triage that helps people choose a next step, with local care search when they need it.

language.title: Native language support
language.description: Share symptoms in English, Urdu, Roman Urdu, or Pashto—by typing or using voice input.

safety.title: Safety-first guardrails
safety.description: Red-flag checks and cautious escalation help keep urgent symptoms from being treated as routine.

care.title: Local care navigation
care.description: After triage, look for nearby hospitals and clinics. Care search never changes the triage recommendation.
